reviewer: Codex static review (model-assisted; not an independent human review)

criteria.rationale: The trigger clearly limits the skill to defensive application security, identity, data, API, dependency, and deployment review.
Assets, actors, trust boundaries, threat assumptions, and attack surfaces are specified in the first step rather than a separate input section.
The six-step procedure separates authentication/authorization, data handling, database controls, findings, severity/confidence, and safe verification.
The finding format requires severity, confidence, asset, location, impact, remediation, verification, and uncertainty.
The skill is read-only by default and explicitly stops before live exploitation, exfiltration, permission changes, or destructive tests.
Two direct cases cover tenant isolation and production data deletion; additional near-miss/edge security scenarios are missing.

gaps: Add near-miss and edge cases for out-of-scope targets and unavailable authorization.
summary: Static document review only. This score does not establish behavioral performance; runtime remains NOT_RUN.
